subscriptions.cleanup100: Keep latest 100: clean up older articles

filters.title: Filter rules
filters.intro: Rules run on every new article as it arrives — and, when you save, on matching articles you already have. Skip noisy keywords, or auto mark-read / star the things you care about.
filters.confirmSkipMessage: This discard rule matches {{count}} articles you already have. Saving will permanently delete them — this can't be undone. New articles will still be filtered going forward.

sync.syncHint: Syncing pulls subscriptions from your server and aligns read / starred state both ways. It also runs automatically each time feeds are refreshed.
sync.connectHint: Connect to a self-hosted FreshRSS or Miniflux server to sync subscriptions and reading state across devices.
sync.minifluxPassHint: Miniflux requires an application password — create one under Settings → API Keys in your Miniflux account.
sync.reasonOauth: Requires OAuth developer credentials, not yet supported
sync.reasonEntitlements: Requires native macOS entitlements, not yet supported

advanced.cleanupForever: Currently set to keep forever, no cleanup performed
advanced.concurrencyDesc: How many feeds to refresh at the same time at most

advanced.aiApiKeyDesc: The key is stored only in the local database and is never uploaded

advanced.translateLangDesc: Default language articles are translated into. Defaults to the interface language; switchable per article from the reader

webdav.hint: Sync your library, nested folders and tags, reading progress, read status, stars, read-later, highlights and notes across devices. Concurrent edits are reviewed below. Credentials stay local. Saved summary prompts, AI provider, model and reasoning effort sync through WebDAV. API keys, ChatGPT sign-in and custom endpoints stay on this device. Compressed chunks and incremental transfers support large libraries. The first sync transfers all content; keep the app open and allow local storage for sync staging. Update every device before syncing.
webdav.neverSynced: Connected. Choose Sync now to merge your library.
webdav.conflictHint: {{count}} conflicts need a choice. Both versions are preserved locally. Resolve them, then choose Sync now.
webdav.cycle: These moves would form a hierarchy cycle. Keep a valid version or move the tag/folder to the top level.
webdav.conflictNotice: WebDAV needs a conflict decision. Open Settings → Sync to choose a version.
webdav.missingParent: The parent tag was moved, renamed or deleted elsewhere. Move this tag to the top level to keep its content and continue syncing.
webdav.networkHint: Local WebDAV settings only. Increase concurrency for high latency; reduce it if the server rate-limits. The next run uses a fresh proxy connection.
webdav.mobileProxyHint: 127.0.0.1 on iPhone refers to the phone itself. Use a proxy reachable from the phone, or its VPN / TUN.
webdav.networkSaved: Saved for the next WebDAV run
webdav.directoryHint: Creates Papr under the WebDAV address by default. Choose a name, or leave blank to use the address itself. For InfiniCLOUD, use the /dav/ URL from Apps Connection, not the /browser/ page. If the address already includes the full folder path, leave the folder field blank.
webdav.relocateHint: Copies on the server when supported and retains the original folder. Interrupted work can be retried; unsupported COPY falls back to transfer. Point all devices to the same new folder before syncing.

phases.failed: Sync incomplete; see the error below

webdav.scheduleHint: Defaults to 1 hour. Failed or cancelled runs also wait for this interval. Manual only disables timer, foreground and network recovery triggers. Keep the app running on macOS; iOS background execution is limited; keep the app in the foreground to finish syncing. This preference is local to this device.

codex.modelAfterLogin: Sign in to choose a model for summaries, article chat and AI translation.
codex.effortDesc: Used for summaries, article chat and AI translation. Higher effort usually takes longer. Options depend on the model.

summaryPrompt.hint: Customize structure, tone and length. Article text and original image links are attached automatically; no placeholders are needed. Saved changes apply to the next generation. Regenerate an existing summary to update it.

sidebar.allReadHint: No unread feeds — all caught up.
sidebar.dropUngroup: Drop here to remove from folder
sidebar.deleteTag: Delete tag (children move to top level)
sidebar.tagsEmptyHint: Tag articles while reading to group them here.
sidebar.toastFolderWithFeedsDeleted: Removed folder, descendant subscriptions and articles
sidebar.tagCountHint: Includes articles assigned here and to all descendants; each article is counted once.

error.webdavInvalidUrl: Enter an HTTP(S) directory URL without embedded credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
error.feedCleanupChanged: Articles changed. Review a fresh cleanup preview before confirming.
error.webdavAuthFailed: WebDAV authentication failed. Check the username and password.
error.webdavEtagRequired: This WebDAV server does not provide strong ETags. Safe multi-device sync is unavailable.
error.webdavTooLarge: A single sync record exceeds 64 MiB, or the manifest is too large. There is no 128 MiB limit on the whole library.
error.webdavInvalidData: The WebDAV library file is invalid. Local data was not replaced.
error.webdavVersion: This WebDAV library was created by an unsupported protocol version. Update Papr.
error.webdavConflict: The remote manifest kept changing during sync. Nothing was overwritten; please retry later.
error.webdavSyncFailed: The last WebDAV sync failed. Choose Sync now to retry and see the error.
error.syncProviderConflict: Disconnect the current sync service before connecting another one.
error.folderCycle: A folder cannot be moved into itself or one of its descendants.
error.codexMissing: Codex CLI was not found. Install the official @openai/codex CLI, then restart Papr (see docs/codex.md).
error.codexLoginRequired: Sign in with ChatGPT in Settings → Advanced → AI before using Codex.
error.tagCycle: A tag cannot be moved inside itself or one of its children.
error.webdavNeedsResolution: Sync is paused: review the conflicts below, then sync again.
error.webdavConflictGone: This conflict has already been resolved. Refresh the list.
error.webdavConflictChanged: This item changed while you were deciding. Sync again to refresh the conflict.
error.invalidTagPath: Invalid tag path. Use / for levels and ; between tags; level names cannot be empty.
error.summaryPromptTooLong: Summary prompts support up to 12,000 characters.
error.codexMobileUnsupported: iOS cannot run the desktop Codex sign-in component. Choose an API provider and enter this device’s API key. Provider/model changes also sync through WebDAV.
error.webdavInvalidNetwork: Use 1–8 parallel chunks and a 60–1800 second timeout.
error.webdavInvalidProxy: Enter a valid HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5 or SOCKS5h proxy URL.
error.webdavProxyPac: System PAC is enabled. Set an explicit WebDAV proxy, or use direct mode with VPN / TUN.
error.webdavBrowserUrl: This is the browser URL. Use the WebDAV /dav/ address from Apps Connection.
error.webdavInvalidDirectory: Enter one folder name without slashes or parent paths.
error.webdavDirectoryOccupied: The destination contains a different Papr library. Choose a new folder.
error.webdavCopyUnsupported: The server cannot copy this legacy library. Complete a regular sync before changing folders.
error.webdavCancelled: Transfer stopped. Completed chunks can be reused next time.
error.webdavRateLimited: The server is rate-limiting requests. Retry later or reduce concurrency.
error.webdavPreconditionFailed: The server rejected the manifest version check (HTTP 412), but a fresh read found no change. This does not indicate another device is uploading. Retry; if it persists, check the WebDAV service or proxy ETag support.
error.webdavRemoteConflict: The server refused to publish the manifest (HTTP 409). Check that the sync directory exists, is writable and is not locked by the server. The previous remote manifest is preserved.
error.webdavBusy: A sync or connection operation is already running on this device. Please wait.
error.webdavInvalidSchedule: Choose a sync interval from 0 to 1440 minutes.
